title: NRG Assessment Tool — Control Definition Schema v2.0
description: Validates Config/controls.json against the ACTUAL v4.x control shape (13 required keys per control; References with 9 required framework citations plus optional SCuBA). v1 of this schema described a retired design (NRG-AAD-0001 IDs, Profile/RawDataKeys/EvidenceFormat/Tags/Owner fields) that never matched shipped data, so it was never enforceable. v2 is enforced in CI (ci.yml, Schema Validation step) and mirrors the ScubaGear practice of machine-validating tool configuration before use.

ControlId.description: Workload-prefixed dotted ID, e.g. AAD-1.1. Prefix must match the Workload field.

CollectorDependency.description: Raw-data key the evaluator reads (e.g. AAD-AuthPolicies, Teams-Config).

EvaluatorFunction.description: Function name in Evaluators/ — must exist and be exported.

CISControls.description: CIS Controls v8.1 safeguard IDs (validated against the authoritative list by Testing/NRG.FrameworkAccuracy.Tests.ps1).

CIS.description: CIS Microsoft 365 Foundations Benchmark recommendation number.

SCuBA.description: Optional CISA ScubaGear policy ID (empty string = no SCuBA equivalent). Semantic match to the baseline text is guarded by Testing/NRG.FrameworkAccuracy.Tests.ps1 against Config/framework-baselines/scuba-ids-v2.0.0.txt.
